app.tagline: Hire someone nearby in your own language.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: We'll send a code to your phone.
login.wrongCode: That phone number or code is wrong.

errors.offline: Can't reach Fixa. Check your connection and try again.
errors.changed: Something changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid: Check what you entered and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries today. Try again tomorrow.

translation.unsure: This may not have translated well

trust.title: Trust range
trust.explainer: Built only from confirmed jobs. The range narrows as the record grows.

home.describeJobHint: Say what's wrong in your own words. We'll find someone nearby.
home.nearbyHint: See who does the work around {{suburb}} before you post a job.
home.noJobsBody: Describe what needs fixing, and people nearby can send you quotes.

newJob.title: New job
newJob.subtitle: Your address and number stay hidden until you pick someone.
newJob.describeExample: My geyser is leaking through the ceiling

providers.title: Who can help
providers.subtitle: Ranked by real work, not stars. New people get a fair chance too.
providers.waitingTitle: Quotes come to your job page
providers.waitingBody: People who do this work nearby can see your job and send quotes. You choose from them there.
providers.emptyTitle: Nobody nearby does this work yet
providers.emptyBody: Your job stays open, and anyone new who does this work can still quote.

nearby.title: Who works near you
nearby.subtitle: People doing this work around {{suburb}}. To get quotes, describe your job and we'll ask the ones who fit.
nearby.emptyBody: Try a wider radius, or any language.
nearby.describeHint: We'll show your job to people nearby who can take it, and you choose from their quotes.

job.title: Your job
job.waitingForProvider: Waiting for {{name}} to confirm. Contact details unlock when they do.
job.noQuotesBody: People nearby can see your job. Their quotes show here as they arrive.
job.acceptedBody: Confirm to see the address and phone numbers, or decline if you can't do the job.
job.cancelConfirm: Cancel this job? This can't be undone.

contact.lockedBody: Phone numbers and the address unlock when the provider confirms the job.

chat.privacyNote: Numbers and addresses stay hidden until the job is confirmed.
chat.emptyBody: Say hello, or ask about the job.
chat.pickThreadBody: Each person who quoted has their own chat. Open one from their quote on your job page.

feed.title: Jobs near you
feed.subtitle: You see the suburb and the problem. Details unlock after you're confirmed.
feed.acceptedNote: A customer accepted your quote. Open the job to confirm it.
feed.emptyBody: Jobs in your trades show here as customers post them.

verifyId.title: Verify your ID
verifyId.subtitle: A checked ID helps customers trust you.
verifyId.consentBody: We check your ID number with Home Affairs through Smile ID. We keep only the result, never your ID details.
verifyId.resultBody: Your badge shows on your profile.
verifyId.numberOk: This number looks right. Date of birth: {{date}}.

reason.length: An SA ID number has 13 digits.
reason.date: The first 6 digits should be your date of birth (YYMMDD).
reason.checksum: There's a typo in this number. Check it against your ID.

verifyId.namesLabel: Your names, as on your ID

result.verified: Home Affairs confirmed who you are.
result.nameMismatch: Home Affairs has this number, but the names don't match. Check the spelling and try again.
result.notFound: Home Affairs couldn't find this number. Your ID number badge stays.

offApp.title: Log a past job
offApp.subtitle: Work you did outside the app counts too.
offApp.smsNoteBody: It counts once they reply YES. We never show their number to anyone.
offApp.sentBody: We sent them an SMS. The job counts on your record once they reply YES.

error.self_confirmation: You can't confirm your own job. Enter your customer's number.
error.invalid_phone: Enter the customer's cellphone number, like 082 123 4567.
error.invalid_date: The date must be in the past, within the last 10 years.
error.duplicate: You already logged a job for this customer on this date.
error.monthly_cap: You've logged the most past jobs allowed this month.
error.customer_busy: This customer got too many requests today. Try again tomorrow.
error.sms_failed: We couldn't text the customer. Try again in a moment.

record.title: My record
record.subtitle: Proof of your work, to share or use for ARPL.
record.arplTarget: of the {{years}} years of experience ARPL asks for
record.verifyCodeHint: Anyone can check your record is genuine
record.noArplTrade: ARPL covers trades with a merSETA toolkit, and yours aren't on the list yet. Your record still counts.
record.pdfDownloaded: Your PDF is downloaded. Anyone can check it with the verify code.
record.linkCopied: Link copied. Paste it into WhatsApp or an SMS.
record.noJobs: There are no confirmed jobs on your record yet. A job counts once its customer confirms it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link may be old or mistyped.
